learning_outcomes.text: Demonstrate the ability to analyze and synthesize.
Demonstrate skills for planning, organization, and strategy.
Acquire the ability to effectively solve problems.
Express oneself correctly in Spanish, both orally and in writing.
Possess knowledge of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT).
Acquire skills related to the use of computer programs for calculation, data analysis, and processing within their field of application.
Develop the ability to work in a team.
Acquire commitment to ethics and social responsibility.
Ability to apply knowledge to practice.
Acquire the ability for autonomous learning and concern for knowledge and continuous training.
Motivation for quality and continuous improvement.
Basic knowledge of industrial production systems.
Knowledge and abilities to organize and manage projects. Know the organizational structure and functions of a project office.
Ability to organize, plan, and manage within the scope of a company, and other institutions and organizations.

syllabus_topics: The Productive Function of the Company
assessment_rules: The course can only be passed if the student obtains the expected results. Theoretical and practical tests each require a minimum score of 4 out of 10. Attendance to at least 75% of laboratory practicals is mandatory. If minimums are not met, the global grade will be calculated according to the UBU's Evaluation Regulations.
